retention_clock_start: The most recent transition to completed status, stored as completed_at in UTC.

automatic_deletion.eligibility: status is completed, completed_at is at or before current time minus 30 days, and legal_hold is false
automatic_deletion.action: Permanently delete message bodies, attachments, and participant identifiers.
automatic_deletion.failure_behavior: Record a failure metric without sensitive content and retry the item on the next hourly run.

reopened_behavior: A reopened conversation is not deletion-eligible. A later completion writes a new completed_at value and restarts the 30-day clock.
hold_behavior: Records under an active legal hold are excluded until a separately authorized release is recorded.
